name: British National Bibliography API
tagline: British Library Linked Data API for UK published works via SPARQL and RDF.
description: Public Linked Data interface to the British National Bibliography (BNB), exposing UK national bibliography records as RDF over HTTP and SPARQL. Used for bibliographic lookup of books and other UK-published works; heritage open-data style access rather than a modern REST product API.

auth.details: No authentication required for public SPARQL and Linked Data endpoints; open access bibliographic data.

use_cases: look up UK published books by title or ISBN in BNB
run SPARQL queries over British National Bibliography RDF
resolve bibliographic Linked Data URIs for UK works
build library catalog enrichment from open BNB data
